WITH funding_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG((ss.boxy - ss.boxx) / NULLIF(ss.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
    SUM(ss.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
with_cross_source_average AS (
  SELECT
    fundflux,
    avg_y_vs_x_difference,
    area_to_volume_ratio,
    AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) OVER () AS cross_source_average
  FROM funding_metrics
)
SELECT
  fundflux,
  avg_y_vs_x_difference,
  area_to_volume_ratio,
  area_to_volume_ratio - cross_source_average AS above_cross_source_average
FROM with_cross_source_average
WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > cross_source_average;
